queue.topic: Succession under the Dayabhaga school as followed in West Bengal and by Bengali Hindu families in Kolkata: how Dayabhaga differs from Mitakshara (no birth right in ancestral property, positions of sons and daughters, joint family property before and after the Hindu Succession Act 1956 and the 2005 amendment), intestate succession in West Bengal, wills and probate before the Calcutta High Court, partition suits, common title problems. Link the existing intestate-succession article and the ancestral-property guide; do not repeat them.

Forum map for civil and commercial disputes in Kolkata: Calcutta High Court original side versus appellate side, pecuniary and territorial jurisdiction, the Commercial Division and Commercial Courts Act 2015 in West Bengal, pre-institution mediation under Section 12A, City Civil Court and district courts, arbitration seat in Kolkata, execution of decrees. Do not repeat the existing Noida commercial-courts article; link it for comparison.

Industrial and commercial plots in Noida and Greater Noida for businesses and investors: allotment and lease from NOIDA, GNIDA and YEIDA, lease deed terms, permission to mortgage and sublet, transfer and change of use, default and cancellation, remedies before the authority, High Court writ and civil court. Confirm current authority policies from official notices; leave out any figure that cannot be confirmed. Link the existing Noida real-estate and recovery articles.

Commercial premises leases in Kolkata and Noida: registration and stamp duty differences between West Bengal and Uttar Pradesh, lock-in and escalation, security deposit, unregistered leases and Section 107 Transfer of Property Act, eviction routes, arrears recovery, sub-letting, rent-law coverage. Link the existing UP/Delhi tenant guide; do not repeat it.

Municipal and building-law remedies in Kolkata: Kolkata Municipal Corporation building plan sanction, unauthorised construction and demolition notices, hearing and appeal under the Kolkata Municipal Corporation Act 1980, Municipal Building Tribunal, writ jurisdiction of the Calcutta High Court against municipal action, neighbours' remedies and typical timelines. State only what can be confirmed from the Act and reported decisions.

Managing Indian property while living abroad: rent agreements and collection, tenant default and eviction under State rent laws, caretakers and property managers, property tax, utility and society transfers, insurance, protection against encroachment, and the documents an NRI landlord should hold. Do not repeat the existing guides on illegal occupation recovery.
